subject: EU AI champions initiative & scaling data annotation
text:
Hi [NAME],

I just saw that [COMPANY] was mentioned as part of the EU AI champions
initiative, very exciting!

I thought I'd reach out because I saw you were doing some work on adding
unstructured data to processed datasets through text annotation efforts to
fine tune some processes (e.g. access requests). We recently onboard a
couple clients with a similar use case as you, working with the likes of
Philips, Baker Hughes & StandardAI.

Teams tend to come to us when they're looking to scale their AI
initiatives, so thought it would be a good time to reach out as this seems
to be the case given [COMPANY]' recent commitment.

For some context, Encord is an SF-based data development platform (recently
raised our Series B) built to help computer vision teams get better models
to market, faster. 150+ of the world's top AI teams are leveraging Encord
to:

   - Easily curate, manage, visualise & search their unstructured training
   data at scale
   - Build active learning workflows to analyse both raw & labelled data,
   identifying model blindspots & find rare edge case
   - Automate parts of their annotation process - typically seeing 6-10x
   throughput gain

Would you be interested to learn more? Pretty wide open most mornings this
week for a chat.

subject: Woven by Toyota's data curation - why you might care
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

We've recently onboarded Woven by Toyota as customers, so I thought it'd make sense to reach out to see if we can help you and the team in a similar way.

Like hundreds of CV & ML Ops teams who have come to us with their challenges, Woven's Computer Vision team faced problems with data curation (Voxel51 & internal tools), where they lacked the speed & scalability required to efficiently search through their training datasets.

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing and searching through billions of video and image data items (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters & natural language searches), enabling CV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Are you open to exploring with me how Encord can help you and the team with your CV data development challenges?

How does a time suit for a call in the coming days? (Or any times here: [LINK] suit?)

Very best,

subject: [NAME], saw the article in Insider Sport - a conversation?
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw the article from Feb 3rd in Insider Sport and wanted to specifically
reach out to you. (You might see my LinkedIn connect too.)

I'm [SENDER] - the team and I work with a lot of global teams on the
pain points of leveraging Computer Vision in sports analytics, particularly
around things like dynamic classifications.

We work with folks like Hudl, Veo, Spiideo & MVP - a big focus on sports video
use cases.

Our platform offers:

   - *Native Video Editor*: Apply and extrapolate (no need to apply to
   individual frames) as well as allowing for multi-frame object detection.
   Massively reducing annotation time.
   - *Infinite nesting & dynamic classifications*: track physical through
   frames such as walking, jogging, running and jumping.
   - *Key moment identification*: uncover unique periods and edge cases in
   matches and training data automatically.

I wanted to ask if you and the team would be up for a chat?

I think there could be some valuable opportunities to explore your training
data pipelines for your Computer Vision Model Development.
